review_method: Rendered every page of the exact compiled PDF to PNG and reviewed six contact sheets covering pages 1-45, including the title page, equations, all tables, all eight figures, flow diagrams, discussion, and bibliography.
review_notes: A4 page geometry and margins are consistent.
No clipped figures, captions, tables, or equations were observed.
Tables and plotted labels remain legible at normal PDF zoom.
Research-process disclosure and data/code availability sections are present.
References and citations are visible in the final pages.
The PDF reports mathematical/synthetic results only and explicitly does not report biological validation.
